# 斯特林格級服務接駁車
[color=#a4885c]船隻大小：[/color] 小型
[color=#a4885c]建議船員人數：[/color] 2 人以上
[color=#a4885c]發電類型：[/color] 鈾

「一艘小型穿梭機，配備錄音室與採訪室，採訪室內設有全息平板，可在節目直播時進行即時通話，此外還設有新聞編輯室。」 Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries."
# 操作 LVHI Stringer 穿梭機的要訣： - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]22 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. The button with the gray frame controls the mini anchor.
- For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
